plain.li: {ABOUT_nameDef} is locked in a cell with nothing to fight with. I won't call killing {ABOUT_objective} justice.
If we start executing prisoners, where does it stop?
I stitched {ABOUT_nameDef} up myself. I'm not going to stand there and watch {ABOUT_objective} die.
[afterraid] We're all still angry about yesterday. This isn't the day to decide who dies.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef}, please. I know you're angry, and I know why. This won't help.
{ABOUT_nameDef} has family somewhere, waiting for {ABOUT_objective} to come home.
[trait:Kind] I'll feed {ABOUT_nameDef} from my own plate if that's the problem. Just don't do this.

blunt.li: You want blood, {OTHER_nameDef}, go hunt a muffalo. Leave the prisoner alone.
You'll have to go through me first.

cheerful.li: Can we not kill the prisoner? {ABOUT_nameDef} and I were just starting to get along!

gloomy.li: We keep killing people who've already lost. I don't recognize us anymore.

cold.li: An execution upsets the others and loses us the ransom. It's poor value.
{ABOUT_nameDef} could be recruited, sold or ransomed. A corpse can only be buried.

plain.li: We let {ABOUT_nameDef} go, and next season {ABOUT_pronoun}'s back with twenty friends and a good idea of where our walls are weak.
{OTHER_nameDef} wants to free {ABOUT_nameDef}? The same {ABOUT_nameDef} who was trying to kill us last week?
[afterraid] Their blood is still on the floor. It's too soon to be letting anyone go.

warm.li: I know you mean well, {OTHER_nameDef}. But I've seen what people like {ABOUT_nameDef} do to people like you.

blunt.li: Free {ABOUT_nameDef}? Fine. Then you can explain it to whoever {ABOUT_pronoun} kills next.
[trait:Bloodlust] I had plans for {ABOUT_nameDef}. Don't ask what they were.

cheerful.li: I'm all for second chances, but not for people who came here to rob us!

gloomy.li: They thank you, they walk off, and they come back with more. They always do.

cold.li: {ABOUT_nameDef} knows our layout and how many of us can fight. Releasing {ABOUT_objective} gives that away for nothing.
[trait:Psychopath] We've invested a lot of food in {ABOUT_nameDef}. I'd like a return on it.

plain.li: I miss {ABOUT_nameDef} too. But attacking a whole settlement to get one person back could cost us three.
We're farmers and cooks. We're not an army.
Whoever goes in after {ABOUT_nameDef} might not come back either.

blunt.li: {ABOUT_nameDef} is gone. Stop planning a war we'll lose.

gloomy.li: I'm sorry, but they're probably dead already.

cold.li: Getting {ABOUT_nameDef} back means risking several of us to save one.
[trait:Psychopath] We can take someone with the same skills from the next raid. It's cheaper.
